games.title: Jallikattu
games.description: Jallikattu is an ancient bull-taming spectacle from Tamil Nadu, India, that dates back over 2,000 years. Unlike Spanish bullfighting, the goal is not to kill the animal but to "embrace" it as a show of bravery and skill.
howToPlay: Step 1: Register your bull and yourself with the local Collector at least three days before the event.
Step 2: Pass a medical checkup for both the participant and the bull to ensure fitness and no intoxication.
Step 3: Wait at the arena known as the Vadi Vasal (narrow entrance) while spectators stay behind double barricades.
Step 4: Watch for the bull as it is released from the Vadi Vasal into the open arena.
Step 5: Pounce on the bull immediately but only hold onto its large hump with both arms.
Step 6: Avoid the horns, neck, and tail, as touching these parts will lead to immediate disqualification.
Step 7: Cling to the hump while the bull tries to shake you off through jumping or bolting.
Step 8: Maintain your grip for at least 15 meters, 30 seconds, or until the bull completes three jumps.
Step 9: Release the bull once it crosses the finish line or exit point to avoid being debarred.
Step 10: Claim your prize, which may be coins tied to the horns or other rewards announced by organizers.
